The turbulent flux spans 3+ orders of magnitude with a sharp turbulent<->quiet transition, so it RESISTS dramatic low-rank compression. An honest counter to the naive 'flux is trivially low-rank' expectation. Classical SVD/MPS; NO quantum-advantage claim.
caveats: NOT a dramatic low-rank collapse: bond-dim-2 keeps ~91% variance but ~30% rel-L2 error
classical SVD/MPS ROM of real CGYRO data — a many-body / quantum-bridge method, NOT a quantum-advantage claim
